sentence: Written in Python, SQL and JavaScript: 17 Python files invent the history, predict parts, load trucks, ask Claude, replay dispatch, write the pages and check it all; 16 SQL files hold the tables and the 15 metric queries; 2 JavaScript files run the hints and switches. Beside them, 7 Bash scripts run the checks before each commit, and 3 HTML files and 1 CSS file lay out the pages.
